summary: Two-stage vtable dispatch on a thiscall object. Calls the check method (vtable slot +0x18, i.e. vtable[6]) and, when it returns non-zero, invokes sub_4D7FE0. Independently, when the byte flag at this+0x8 is non-zero, invokes PhaseBasedAudioParticleEnvelope. Finally dispatches the method at vtable +0x4 (vtable[1]) and returns its result.

operations.description: Dispatch the check/query method through the vtable pointer stored at this+0x0, at vtable offset +0x18 (slot 6); its non-zero result gates the next call.
If the check method returned non-zero, invoke sub_4D7FE0(this).
Call sub_4D7FE0(this) when the check method result was non-zero.
If the flag byte at this+0x8 is non-zero, invoke PhaseBasedAudioParticleEnvelope(this).
Call PhaseBasedAudioParticleEnvelope(this) when the flag at this+0x8 is set.
Dispatch the final method through the vtable pointer at this+0x0, at vtable offset +0x4 (slot 1); this always executes.
Return the integer result produced by the final vtable dispatch.
